name: Ofgem Connect update: demand connections reform
fact: Published 16 June 2026; Ofgem says the demand queue is large, includes likely non-viable projects, and well-progressed projects can be delayed by network/generation build and blockers.
gate: System-wide reform context is not a project-specific connection offer, queue position or energisation date.

name: Ofgem demand connections reform call for input
fact: The call-for-input page records the Curate, Plan and Connect reform structure and was updated 16 June 2026 with a response summary.
gate: Consultation/reform options are not final project-level connection rules or capacity reservations.

name: Ofgem Gate 2 to Whole Queue offer timetable
fact: Decision published 3 June 2026 agrees a re-baselined phased timetable for Gate 2 connection offers through 2026, with the final batch expected by mid-March 2027.
gate: A programme timetable does not identify whether a particular project has Gate 2 status or a firm connection date.

name: Ofgem TMO4+ distribution licence modifications
fact: The concluded Ofgem process created a pass-through mechanism for DNO TMO4+ implementation costs; modifications took effect 27 January 2026.
gate: Licence-cost recovery supports reform implementation but is not network headroom or a connection offer.

name: P209 Former Joinery Works, Nelson
fact: Pendle authoritative entry dated 27 January 2026 records 0.88ha, deliverable, 40-50 dwellings and not-permissioned.
gate: Deliverable/not-permissioned register status is not consent; exact title, planning history and canonical geometry remain required.

name: P257 Land at Giles Street, Nelson
fact: Pendle authoritative entry dated 27 January 2026 records 0.93ha, public ownership, 35-37 dwellings, deliverable and not-permissioned.
gate: Public ownership and allocation context do not prove land control for a scheme, permission or delivery timing.

name: P064 Brook Shed, Earby
fact: Pendle authoritative entry dated 27 January 2026 records 1.32ha, deliverable, full permission dated 7 September 2023 and 50 dwellings.
gate: Permissioned register status still requires live implementation/completion and exact parcel verification.

name: BK090 rear of Greyhound Pub, Barnoldswick
fact: Pendle authoritative entry dated 27 January 2026 records 0.22ha, full permission for 9 dwellings and notes work had not started; the notes also record uncertainty about owner intentions.
gate: A historic permission plus stated intent does not prove current commencement, viability or remaining capacity.

name: BK116 St Andrews Methodist Church
fact: Pendle authoritative entry dated 27 January 2026 records 0.14ha, full permission for 6 apartments and notes no work had started.
gate: Permission without current commencement/completion evidence is not a verified future-growth candidate.

name: FE027 Chapel Farm Garage
fact: Pendle authoritative entry dated 27 January 2026 records 0.38ha, deliverable and outline permission for 12 dwellings dated 13 January 2022.
gate: Outline permission requires current reserved-matters/delivery checks and exact geometry before promotion.

name: CE201 58-60 Brown Street West, Colne
fact: Pendle authoritative entry dated 27 January 2026 records a full permission for 10 residential apartments and notes work has started on site.
gate: Started development may already consume future capacity; remaining undeveloped quantum must be verified before any candidate use.

name: NN154 68-70 Manchester Road, Nelson
fact: Planning Data marks the Pendle record out of date with end date 6 December 2021; historic full permission covered 8 flats.
gate: Out-of-date/end-dated record is a rejection control and must not be treated as current development capacity.

name: NN103 Marsden Hall Farm
fact: Planning Data marks the record out of date with end date 6 December 2021; notes state the 8-dwelling scheme is complete.
gate: Explicit completion is a hard rejection for future-growth promotion unless a new authoritative redevelopment record exists.

name: P315 Land at Croft Mill, Foulridge
fact: Pendle record has entry date 27 January 2026 but is marked out of date with end date 3 December 2024; historic full permission covered 17 dwellings.
gate: End-dated record is historical evidence only and not a current candidate.

name: BR00203 Barry's Garage, Brent
fact: Brent authoritative entry dated 10 April 2026 records 0.56ha, 40 dwellings, not-permissioned and Local Plan allocation BSSA9.
gate: Allocation plus register capacity is not planning permission; current availability, title and exact parcel relation remain required.

name: 697 Land at Wey Hill, Haslemere
fact: Waverley authoritative brownfield record is deliverable, public-owned, records 34 dwellings and is not-permissioned.
gate: Public ownership and deliverability do not prove consent, disposal availability or infrastructure readiness.

name: P/21/0785/2 106A Derby Road, Loughborough
fact: Charnwood authoritative entry dated 23 December 2025 records 8 flats but planning-permission status is not-permissioned because the residential permission was superseded by a non-residential permission.
gate: Historic permission type/date must not override the current not-permissioned status.

name: SH148 Charnwood brownfield site
fact: Charnwood authoritative entry dated 23 December 2025 records 8-32 dwellings and a historic full-permission date, while current planning-permission status is not-permissioned.
gate: Current status controls; historic permission fields cannot be promoted without resolving the supersession/history.

name: RBBCBLR008 Reigate and Banstead
fact: Reigate and Banstead entry dated 10 January 2026 is permissioned but has end date 31 December 2023; historic appeal permission covered a multi-block residential redevelopment.
gate: End-dated record is historical and is rejected as a current candidate unless a newer authoritative record supersedes it.

name: RBBCBLR024 Former Copyhold Works, Redhill
fact: Reigate and Banstead authoritative entry dated 10 January 2026 records 1.11ha, deliverable and notes the site forms part of wider allocation ERM2/3 with delivery dependent on policy MLS1.
gate: Allocation/dependency notes are not consent or proof that infrastructure and land assembly are resolved.

name: RBBCBLR077 Reigate and Banstead
fact: Entry dated 10 January 2026 has end date 31 December 2022; notes record a later 14-dwelling permission after an earlier appeal.
gate: End-dated record is historical and must not be counted as current remaining capacity.

name: RBBCBLR016 Reigate and Banstead
fact: Planning Data marks this record out of date with end date 31 December 2021; notes record permission for 10 houses and a site allocation for up to 10 homes.
gate: Out-of-date allocation/permission evidence is not a current candidate.

name: RBBCBLR192 Queensway House, Redhill
fact: Reigate and Banstead authoritative entry dated 10 January 2026 records prior approval for 21 apartments and a 2024 roof-extension permission for 6 additional apartments.
gate: Current implementation and remaining capacity must be checked; prior approval/permission does not prove undeveloped units remain.

name: RBBCBLR191 Waterhouse Lane, Kingswood
fact: Reigate and Banstead authoritative entry dated 10 January 2026 records 0.13ha, deliverable and full permission dated 3 April 2024 for 9 apartments.
gate: Permissioned status requires current commencement/completion and exact parcel checks before promotion.

name: RBBCBLR180 Prospect Wells House, Chipstead
fact: Planning Data marks the record out of date with end date 31 December 2023; historic full permission covered 10 residential units.
gate: End-dated record is a rejection control, not current capacity.

name: RBBCBLR193 Redcentral, Redhill
fact: Reigate and Banstead authoritative entry dated 10 January 2026 records prior approval granted August 2024 for office-to-residential conversion to 95 apartments.
gate: Prior approval does not prove the scheme remains unimplemented or all 95 units remain future capacity.

name: RBBCBLR096 Reigate and Banstead
fact: Planning Data marks the record out of date with end date 31 December 2023; historic prior approvals covered storage-to-residential conversions.
gate: Out-of-date record is historical evidence only and is rejected from current promotion.
